name: Azure Sentinel Honeypot Attack Map
description: Global visualization of brute force attacks against Azure Sentinel honeypot

groups.value:
# Azure Sentinel Honeypot Attack Map

Real-time visualization of global brute force attacks targeting the RDP honeypot. This workbook shows geographic distribution of failed logon attempts, top attacking countries, and temporal trends.
groups.name: markdownText

value.name: minAttempts
value.description: Minimum attempts to display on map

value.query:
let timeRange = todatetime('{{timeRange'}});
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(timeRange)
| where EventID == 4625
| where isnotnull(Country) and Country != 'Unknown'
| summarize 
    AttemptCount = count(),
    UniqueIPs = dcount(IpAddress),
    MostRecent = max(TimeGenerated),
    TopAccount = any(TargetUserName)
by Country, City, Latitude, Longitude
| where AttemptCount >= {{minAttempts}}
| project
    latitude = todouble(Latitude),
    longitude = todouble(Longitude),
    country = Country,
    city = City,
    attempts = AttemptCount,
    uniqueIPs = UniqueIPs,
    mostRecent = MostRecent,
    topAccount = TopAccount
| order by attempts desc

let timeRange = todatetime('{{timeRange'}});
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(timeRange)
| where EventID == 4625
| where isnotnull(Country) and Country != 'Unknown'
| summarize 
    AttemptCount = count(),
    UniqueIPs = dcount(IpAddress)
by Country
| top 10 by AttemptCount desc
| project
    Country,
    Attempts = AttemptCount,
    UniqueIPs

let timeRange = todatetime('{{timeRange'}});
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(timeRange)
| where EventID == 4625
| summarize 
    AttemptCount = count()
by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated
| project
    Timestamp = TimeGenerated,
    Attempts = AttemptCount

let timeRange = todatetime('{{timeRange'}});
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(timeRange)
| where EventID == 4625
| summarize 
    AttemptCount = count(),
    UniqueSourceIPs = dcount(IpAddress),
    Countries = makeset(Country, 10)
by TargetUserName
| top 10 by AttemptCount desc
| project
    TargetAccount = TargetUserName,
    Attempts = AttemptCount,
    UniqueSourceIPs,
    Countries = array_strjoin(Countries, ", ")
